mutation CreateOrganizerTournament($input: CreateOrganizerTournamentInput!) {
  __typename
  createOrganizerTournament(input: $input) {
    __typename
    competeType
    config {
      __typename
      ... on RiftboundTournamentConfig {
        __typename
        deckSubmissionPolicy
        format
        matchFormat
        participantCapacity
        playerFormat
        roundCount
        structure
        tournamentType
        waitlistCapacity
      }
    }
    endsAt
    entryFee {
      __typename
      currency
      minorUnits
    }
    id
    name
    pricing
    registrationEndAt
    registrationPolicy
    registrationStartAt
    shards
    sport
    startsAt
    visibility
  }
}

operations.body:
query GetCompeteSchedule($after: String, $before: String, $eventTypes: [CompeteTournamentType]!, $first: Int, $last: Int, $milestones: [CompeteScheduleMilestone]!, $region: [TftRegion]!, $sport: Sport!) {
  __typename
  competeSchedule(
    sport: $sport
    first: $first
    last: $last
    before: $before
    after: $after
    region: $region
    eventTypes: $eventTypes
    milestones: $milestones
  ) {
    __typename
    edges {
      __typename
      cursor
      node {
        __typename
        ... on CompeteEventScheduleItem {
          __typename
          date
          esportsStageId
          esportsTournamentId
          eventType
          id
          regions
          shards
          sport
        }
        ... on CompeteMilestoneScheduleItem {
          __typename
          date
          esportsTournamentId
          id
          milestoneType
          regions
          shards
          sport
        }
        ... on CompeteSnapshotScheduleItem {
          __typename
          date
          esportsTournamentId
          id
          milestoneType
          regions
          shards
          sport
        }
      }
    }
    pageInfo {
      __typename
      endCursor
      hasNextPage
      hasPreviousPage
      startCursor
    }
    totalCount
  }
}

query GetLoLTeamOverview($hl: Locale!, $sport: [Sport], $teamId: [ID]) {
  __typename
  teams(hl: $hl, sport: $sport, id: $teamId) {
    __typename
    ...LoLOverviewTeam
  }
}

fragment LoLOverviewTeam on Team {
  __typename
  backgroundImage
  code
  homeLeague {
    __typename
    id
    image
    name
    region
    slug
  }
  id
  image
  name
  players {
    __typename
    firstName
    handle

    lastName
    role
    summonerName
  }

}
